negative_reviews.author: amelia batty
negative_reviews.text: would not recommend ever, sushi was definitely not fresh and was dry. spicy chicken teriyaki rice was extremely sickly sweet and unappealing - definitely not spicy, only came with one piece of broccoli for £15. expensive for what it is. there are much better places to eat, will not be returning.

negative_reviews.author: isabella
negative_reviews.text: sushi didn't taste fresh at all and we just weren't keen on our meals especially for such a high price 💔 won't be returning

negative_reviews.author: Daniele Cavoli
negative_reviews.text: Mid ramen. Avoid beef tataki as there's barely any beef there

deliveroo.source: Deliveroo weekly Invoice Statement (order-level, summed) — w/c 2026-09-21 [sales/orders/AOV] + ops from Weekly Summary sheet

issues: Covers rose by 238 week on week (+7.80%) while spend per head fell by £1.14 (-5.35%).
The site noted two Freshers events in the week, with a large number of £5 ramens and free ramens redeemed, which pulled spend per head down.
Sales were up £3,413.98 week on week (+4.73%) and £7,985.03 ahead of target (+11.83%).
Labour came in at 19.07% against a 21% target.
The budget rota is projected at 20.72%, with hours added on both FOH and BOH for FOH deep cleaning and as trade picks up.
Operational F/R came in at 22.11% against a 23% target.
The ice machine is not working, logged as high priority with Francheska responsible.
The skid needs filling (Nathan), logged as medium priority.
The front door is logged as a medium priority maintenance job.
Intangibles and staffing on both FOH and BOH were reported as all good, with no recruitment needed.
The glass wash machine is broken, and Francheska has been asked to book the earliest repair slot.
The sound system cable is broken because it is too short and was repeatedly pulled when connecting iPads, leaving the restaurant without music; a replacement cable was ordered for Friday delivery.
Nathan has filmed the wooden parts that need filling and will send them to Michael for approval.
The front door supplier has said they will email Inka again about the pending repair.
The fryer has a temporary fix with a small backup fryer in place while a new fryer is awaited.
Deliveroo refunds were for missing items, a driver error and a steak described as rare on the menu that arrived well done.
Two negative reviews concerned beef portions on the beef tataki and beef steak takoyaki ramen; prepped portions were to spec, but customers judge portions visually.
A review described the spicy takoyaki rice as too sweet and lacking spice.
Takoyaki ramen broth colour was flagged as needing careful attention.
A review raised fish freshness and dry sushi; the sushi team checks fish every morning and discards substandard stock immediately.
The sushi lead proposed a QR code review system routing satisfied guests to Google Maps and unhappy guests to an internal feedback page; Sophie will consult marketing.
Nori powder for the Christmas menu is unavailable, so shiso powder is being used instead, which changes the taste; supplier samples arrive this week.
A bar meeting is booked for Friday 02/10 from 4pm to 5pm, attended by Amy and Inka.
Two Manchester team members are supporting Leeds, with their hours logged to Leeds.
The new Executive Chef will train at Manchester from Monday to Wednesday after Soho, and the team is asked to support the rota.
